title: Everything NOT in A? Complement Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Ask who did not ride a bicycle to college today. In your class it is a handful of names, in the whole college it is hundreds. Same question, very different answers, because it depends on the full list you count from. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 1, Sets) that idea becomes the complement of a set.

You will watch a live membership test sort Aarav's seven friends into A and A′, grow the universal set U from 10 to 20 and see the complement grow while A stays the same, and compare A′ = U − A with B − A. Then four laws drawn straight from the picture: A ∪ A′ = U, A ∩ A′ = φ, (A′)′ = A, U′ = φ and φ′ = U. A worked example with the primes up to 10 (and why 1 lands in A′), the exam trap of finding a complement without U, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.
